Name: CF Boho Urban Outfitters Furniture
Author: Tanilon
Description:
[center][size=4]❀ Transform your interior ﻿❀[/size]
Do you love Urban Outfitters and want your Stardew room to have the same ﻿aesthetic? This mod is perfect for you. Make your rooms look like your own (dream) home.

This mod works with the Custom furniture mod! This means no furniture gets replaced, you can get your new furniture from Robin or the
catalogue.

[size=4]﻿☼ What's included: ﻿☼
[/size]Grey Corner Sofa
Grey Foot Stool
Brown Wood Gallery Wall
Black Wood Gallery Wall
Patterned Boho Rug
Black and White Rug
Wicker Chair
Tropical Plant Stand
Standing Scandinavian Lamp[size=4]How to install:[/size]

1. Download the zip file
2. Make sure you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1254]Custom Furniture[/url]﻿ installed
3. Unzip in the Mods folder of Stardew Valley


I hope you have fun with this mod, let me know what you think :)

[/center]
